question: On eight fixed canonical P-256 points and six frozen queries, do all four certified isogenies preserve complete signed three-summand relation sets and exact membership under the subgroup-normalized dual inverse?

claims.text: On eight fixed canonical P-256 points and six frozen queries, do all four certified isogenies preserve complete signed three-summand relation sets and exact membership under the subgroup-normalized dual inverse?
No end-to-end ECDLP advantage, method clock, uniform success law, formal certificate or official scientific transition is claimed.
